shortDescription: Synchronize directories in a way similar to rsync.

options.name: arguments
options.description: Dictionary with selected dirsync runtime options.

options.name: destination_directory
options.description: Destination directory that should receive synchronized content.

options.name: exclude_pattern
options.description: List of regex fragments used to exclude matching paths. The fragments are combined into a single regex passed to dirsync.

options.name: include_pattern
options.description: List of regex fragments used to include matching paths. The fragments are combined into a single regex passed to dirsync.

options.name: source_directory
options.description: Source directory that should be synchronized.
